description: Pure, testable zukan (collection) core in @ddm/shared: enumerate the canonical appearance set (tier x form), define the entry key, define the ZukanEntry/Zukan shapes, and the merge/first-seen + counts rules. NO storage, NO DOM. This is the single source of truth that the frontend glue (FEAT-002) and UI (FEAT-003) build on. Create packages/shared/src/zukan.ts, export it from index.ts, and unit-test it in a new shared __tests__ file.
steps: Create packages/shared/src/zukan.ts. Import types { GrowthStage, MonsterForm, Monster } from ./types.ts (type-only) and STAGES from ./stages.ts; import formOf from ./game.ts for reading a monster's form safely. Keep this module pure (no DOM, no storage, no React).

Define the CANONICAL APPEARANCE SET as a derived constant ZUKAN_APPEARANCES: readonly {stageId, form}[]. Rule (document in a top-of-file comment): baby only ever has form 'base' (baby never branches); rookie/champion/ultimate each have the three BRANCH forms {attack, defense, mischief}. EXCLUDE the unreachable 'base' form at rookie/champion/ultimate because shared/evolution.ts chooseEvolutionForm never yields 'base' for non-baby tiers, so a 'base' rookie+/ultimate is not attainable in normal play. Result = baby:base + (rookie|champion|ultimate) x {attack,defense,mischief} = 10 appearances total. Derive the list programmatically from STAGES order and a BRANCH_FORMS = ['attack','defense','mischief'] constant (so baby yields only base) rather than hardcoding, so it stays in sync with STAGES.
Export ZUKAN_TOTAL = ZUKAN_APPEARANCES.length (10) as a derived constant.

Define appearanceKey(stageId, form): string returning `${stageId}:${form}` (e.g. 'baby:base', 'rookie:attack'). Define a monsterAppearanceKey(monster): string = appearanceKey(monster.stageId, formOf(monster)) so callers always key off the normalized form. Document that baby monsters always key as 'baby:base'.

Define interface ZukanEntry { key: string; stageId: GrowthStage; form: MonsterForm; firstSeenAt: number; daysRaised: number; name: string; } and type Zukan = Record<string, ZukanEntry> (keyed by appearanceKey). Document that firstSeenAt + daysRaised + name are captured AT FIRST DISCOVERY of that appearance.

Define daysRaisedAt(bornAt, discoveredAt): number = Math.max(0, Math.floor((discoveredAt - bornAt) / 86_400_000)). Document the definition: whole days elapsed since bornAt at the moment of discovery (floored, clamped >= 0).

Define recordAppearance(zukan: Zukan, monster: Monster, now: number): Zukan — a PURE merge that returns a NEW zukan object (never mutates the input). Compute key = monsterAppearanceKey(monster). If the key already exists, return the zukan UNCHANGED (first-seen wins: do NOT overwrite firstSeenAt/daysRaised; document the chosen policy that we also KEEP the first-seen name so an entry is a stable snapshot of first discovery). Otherwise add a new ZukanEntry with firstSeenAt=now, daysRaised=daysRaisedAt(monster.bornAt, now), name=monster.name, stageId, form=formOf(monster). Only record appearances that are in the canonical set (guard with a Set of canonical keys so a stray/unreachable combo is never stored).

Define discoveredCount(zukan: Zukan): number = count of entries whose key is in the canonical set. Define isDiscovered(zukan, stageId, form): boolean. Define a zukanProgress(zukan) helper returning { discovered: number, total: number } using discoveredCount and ZUKAN_TOTAL.

Define a sanitizeZukan(raw: unknown): Zukan that defensively parses an arbitrary object into a Zukan: keep only entries whose key is canonical and whose fields are well-typed (string name, finite numbers), dropping anything malformed. This is the pure validation used by the storage layer in FEAT-002 so the storage glue stays thin. Pure, no throw.
Add `export * from "./zukan.ts";` to packages/shared/src/index.ts (after the existing exports).

Create packages/shared/src/__tests__/zukan.test.ts following the node:test style of stages.test.ts. Cover: (a) ZUKAN_APPEARANCES enumerates exactly the 10 canonical appearances and ZUKAN_TOTAL===10, and contains baby:base but NOT rookie:base/champion:base/ultimate:base; (b) appearanceKey + monsterAppearanceKey formatting incl. a baby keying as baby:base; (c) daysRaisedAt flooring + clamp (e.g. bornAt now-> 0 days; 2.9 days -> 2; negative elapsed -> 0); (d) recordAppearance adds EXACTLY one entry for a new appearance with correct firstSeenAt/daysRaised/name/stageId/form; (e) recording the SAME appearance again (even with a later now and different name) returns an equal zukan (first-seen preserved: firstSeenAt, daysRaised AND name unchanged) and does NOT increase discoveredCount; (f) recordAppearance never mutates its input (input object identity/content unchanged); (g) recording an unreachable combo (e.g. a hand-built monster with stageId rookie + form base) does NOT add an entry; (h) discoveredCount/zukanProgress counts are correct across several records; (i) sanitizeZukan drops non-canonical keys and malformed entries but keeps valid ones. Build helper monsters inline (createMonster then override stageId/form/bornAt/name).

Run: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; npm run build -w @ddm/shared && npm test. Confirm the shared build passes and shared test count grew above 117 with all passing.
acceptance_criteria: packages/shared/src/zukan.ts exists and is exported from index.ts; `npm run build -w @ddm/shared` passes.
ZUKAN_APPEARANCES has exactly 10 entries (baby:base + rookie/champion/ultimate x {attack,defense,mischief}); ZUKAN_TOTAL===10; no 'base' entry at rookie/champion/ultimate.
recordAppearance adds exactly one entry on first discovery, is a no-op (first-seen preserved) on re-discovery, never mutates input, and ignores non-canonical combos.
daysRaisedAt floors to whole days and clamps to >= 0.
`npm test` (shared) passes with the new zukan.test.ts and a higher-than-117 test count.
findings: Created packages/shared/src/zukan.ts (pure, DOM/storage-free): ZUKAN_APPEARANCES derived from STAGES + BRANCH_FORMS=['attack','defense','mischief'] -> exactly 10 (baby:base + rookie/champion/ultimate x 3 branch forms; non-baby 'base' excluded as unreachable, documented in top-of-file comment). Exported appearanceKey/monsterAppearanceKey (keys off formOf so baby->baby:base), ZukanEntry/Zukan shapes, daysRaisedAt (floor + clamp>=0), recordAppearance (pure first-seen merge: returns same object identity on duplicate/non-canonical, never mutates input, keeps first-seen name), discoveredCount/isDiscovered/zukanProgress, and sanitizeZukan (drops non-canonical keys + malformed entries, never throws). Appended export to index.ts. Added __tests__/zukan.test.ts (9 node:test cases) covering every spec item. Verified: npm run build -w @ddm/shared passes; npm test (shared) 126 pass / 0 fail (baseline was 117). No new deps; no changes to frontend/backend/infra/Monster type.
